unassessed: Other canonical properties and their aliases, intensity/channel behavior and tables
extra_properties callbacks, arbitrary array/protocol subclasses and concurrent mutation
pickle/equality/repr, object assignment/lifecycle, descriptor and private cache fields
huge/sparse maximum labels, allocation failure and nonordinary spacing/offset domains
native implementation, numerical parity or performance credit

safety_audit.label_inputs: Plain NumPy arrays only;2D/3D up to24elements here (bound64), maximum positive label3, fixed integer dtypes. scipy.find_objects allocation proportional to small maxlabel; no arbitrary callbacks/intensity/extra_properties.
safety_audit.empty: Both retained scipy.find_objects source implementations call input.max() before native call, so zero-size shapes raise ValueError safely, captured once as constructor errors.
safety_audit.accepted: find_objects yields label order ascending, skips missing/nonpositive labels. Region image compares cropped input; bbox uses slice; coords argwhere+slice+offset. num_pixels/area onlysum and bounded finite spacing product.
safety_audit.spacing_offset: Finite ordinary positive spacings; valid offset dims fixed; int and fractional offsets source-permitted. Invalid spacing/offset lengths raise source-controlled errors.
safety_audit.mutation: After fixed first read sequence, mutate one input pixel belonging to current label, then reread only four selected properties. Record public cached-vs-fresh effects without reading private cache state.
safety_audit.iteration: Only obtain and project property-name iterator; no getter evaluation for omitted properties.
safety_audit.source_binaries: Observer pins original regionprops/normalization sources and scientific package versions, records actual scipy.ndimage._nd_image binary hash per profile. No cross-build ABI equality claim.

storage_policy: Exact scalar words, array dtype/shape/strides/ownership/layout/writeability/base metadata, per-step values/warnings/errors, alias identity/shares-memory and caller FP state. No normalization of NumPy profile differences.

capture_policy.journal: started flushed before each constructor; completed row or observer_failed retained; never replay a started case

next_gate: Independent source/reference review before any returned-object implementation; other44-property/state partitions remain discovery only.
